520:t_2:141.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Throughout history, we $$スペースノイド$$s have always sought the establishment of self-government.」

520:t_2:142.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is true in every parallel world, and the $$アースノイド$$s in each world never recognize that demand.」

520:t_2:143.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That outcome is also what each world's $$クロノ$$ intends, but...」

520:t_2:144.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's because the $$アースノイド$$s know that the moment they recognize our rights, the positions of master and servant will reverse.」

520:t_2:145.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The reason is clear: space holds a future that the closed world of Earth does not.」

520:t_2:146.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's clear that $$アースノイド$$s clinging to Earth alone will eventually reach limits in energy, food, and economic activity itself.」

520:t_2:147.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「In contrast, $$スペースノイド$$s can be fully self-sufficient without Earth... $$ジオン・ダイクン$$ should have used that fact as his weapon.」

520:t_2:149.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But while he was a great thinker, he was no politician.」

520:t_2:150.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The same goes for the $$ザビ家$$, who twisted $$ジオン$$'s ideals for a war of independence, leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$, and $$ギルバート・デュランダル$$.」

520:t_2:151.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Unless we abandon the notion of making Earth recognize our existence, $$スペースノイド$$s will never win their struggle.」

520:t_2:152.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Are you saying you can bring us that victory?」

520:t_2:153.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If the colonies form an economic pact and exclude Earth, Earth will become a backwater with no economic value...」

520:t_2:154.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then Earth's system of domination will crumble... That is the $$コロニー共栄圏$$ I propose building.」

520:t_2:155.en:
$$レイアム$$
「His argument certainly makes sense...」

520:t_2:156.en:
$$シャア$$
「But that changed with the $$新世時空震動$$ and the existence of $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

520:t_2:157.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It was a kind of revelation to me. What I had to do became clear, and at the same time, you returned to $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:159.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「At the same time, $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, seeing society's reorganization as an opportunity, offered to transfer $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

520:t_2:160.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Whatever it was, I thought it would benefit my plan if it could shake the Federation.」

520:t_2:161.en:
$$シャア$$
「What do you think now that you're subordinate to $$サイデリアル$$?」

520:t_2:162.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Seizing the Box has become a kind of game, but its usefulness remains intact.」

520:t_2:163.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As for the $$コロニー共栄圏$$, the plan is more realistic now that the Empire has destroyed the $$地球連邦$$.」

520:t_2:164.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So you'd hand Earth over to the Empire while the colonies go their own way.」

520:t_2:165.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have no intention of letting invaders run rampant on our mother planet forever, either.」

520:t_2:166.en:
$$シン$$
「You're thinking of fighting the Empire?」

520:t_2:167.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But it would take a different form from the fighting you're imagining.」

520:t_2:168.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I've already set that move in motion.」

520:t_2:169.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You don't intend to tell us about it?」

520:t_2:170.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I will if you swear to become my allies.」

520:t_2:173.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「My plan doesn't even merit consideration?」

520:t_2:174.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Now that I've heard it, it's a worthless proposal. Our views of things are fundamentally incompatible.」

520:t_2:175.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You'd build a $$コロニー共栄圏$$ excluding $$アースノイド$$s... You think we should ignore those who refuse to change, instead of asking them to change...」

520:t_2:176.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That's far from $$ジオン・ダイクン$$'s ideal of human renewal, and far from $$シャア$$'s passion to protect all of Earth and space.」

520:t_2:178.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Are you satisfied with that? Even if the Empire's rule continues, there are people in this world who will never give up fighting.」

520:t_2:179.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Their anger and hatred will also turn toward the $$スペースノイド$$s who claim it's none of their concern.」

520:t_2:180.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That would be a future without harmony or renewal, where fighting continues out of sheer hatred... No, that can't be called a future.」

520:t_2:181.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「A stagnant world where history repeats is no different from being inside the $$時の牢獄$$.」

520:t_2:182.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You intend to replace $$クロノ$$. Why can't you see you're doing the same as they are, never allowing us to advance into the future?」

520:t_2:183.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I understand how you feel, Princess. But this isn't a question of right or wrong.」

520:t_2:184.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I merely made continuing the human world... the present... my first priority.」

520:t_2:185.en:
$$シャア$$
「So you have no intention of continuing this discussion...」

520:t_2:186.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A vessel doesn't think. It merely acts according to the collective will poured into it, to keep all humanity alive.」

520:t_2:187.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...It's as if you think it has nothing to do with you...」

520:t_2:188.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're talking about our future, but your words feel cold, as if it were someone else's affair.」

520:t_2:190.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$... You're a sad man who opens his heart to no one.」

520:t_2:191.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You seem to be saying you're different, $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$.」

520:t_2:192.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「At least I want to be someone who's different.」

520:t_2:193.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「A precious friend taught me that the desire for a future creates power.」

520:t_2:195.en:
$$キラ$$
「Someone who can't connect with another person's heart can't save anyone.」

520:t_2:196.en:
$n
「Because you see it as someone else's affair, you assume you can manipulate people's lives with empty theories.」

520:t_2:197.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「And you confuse the absence of fighting with peace.」

520:t_2:198.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A person like that has no right to speak of the future.」

520:t_2:199.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Continuing the present is the future. I'm simply protecting it.」

520:t_2:200.en:
$$刹那$$
「Now I understand... why you were willing to accept the $$時の牢獄$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

520:t_2:201.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You... aren't looking at the future at all.」

520:t_2:202.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You bastards...! You don't know your place!」

520:t_2:203.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's all right, $$アンジェロ$$. Since they're to become our comrades, we need them to speak their true feelings, too.」

520:t_2:204.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We have no intention of accepting you.」

520:t_2:205.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What we want is tomorrow! We fight so tomorrow will be even a little better than today!」

520:t_2:206.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Would you still do that even if that path leads to despair?」

520:t_2:207.en:
$$シャア$$
「So, as a $$特異点$$, you saw visions of a future of despair, too.」

520:t_2:208.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I can't believe you can still find hope after seeing that.」

520:t_2:209.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But you must have felt it, too: that light that enveloped $$アクシズ$$.」

520:t_2:210.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It was warm... as if everyone's feelings, everyone I know, had come together...」

520:t_2:211.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If people have that kind of potential, it must be able to change the present.」

520:t_2:212.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even so, people don't change. $$クロノ$$ still operates in the shadows, and the Captain couldn't abandon his hatred.」

520:t_2:215.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...People don't change even when you show them possibilities. They'll bury even those possibilities to preserve the present. That's humanity.」

520:t_2:216.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「We can only seek peace and stability within that reality. You should realize the possibilities you speak of can also become a poison that causes conflict.」

520:t_2:218.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If I lack his charisma to guide people, then I'll have to ask you to play that role, Princess.」

520:t_2:219.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You installed a double, and now you want to parade me out?」

520:t_2:220.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll use $$ハマーン$$'s departure. That girl was a puppet she prepared, and we had no choice but to follow her...」
